column60: The Torridon Group is poorly dated directly. Its youngest detrital zircon populations indicate deposition younger than ca. 1050 Ma (as summarized by Krabbendam et al., 2022), while the absence of Cryogenian glacial deposits indicates it is older than ca. 720 Ma. The pole is assigned **ca. 925 Ma (780-1070 Ma)**; in terms of apparent-polar-wander comparison it is quite similar to the ca. 990 Ma Jacobsville pole.
